title: Mancini re-appointed Italy manager
summary: Roberto Mancini has been appointed Italy's head coach for a second stint, returning to the role he previously held. His reappointment brings his World Cup qualification experience back to the Italian national team. The decision represents a significant move for the Italian Football Federation as they chart their path forward.
content: Roberto Mancini is appointed Italy manager for a second time.

zh.title: 曼奇尼重新获任意大利主教练

title: Relive Zidane's World Cup masterclass as he's named France head coach
summary: Zinedine Zidane has been named France's head coach, transitioning from his managerial success at Real Madrid to international football. The article highlights his championship pedigree, recalling his masterclass performance against Brazil in the 2006 World Cup quarter-finals. His appointment marks a major strategic shift for French football.
content: New France head coach Zinedine Zidane produces a masterclass against Brazil in the quarter-finals of the 2006 World Cup.

zh.title: 重温齐达内的世界杯杰作，他被任命为法国主教练

title: Alonso's first Chelsea match was a tale of four strikers
summary: Xabi Alonso's managerial debut at Chelsea was marked by dramatic striker performances, including one player scoring a hat-trick while another faces a potential exit. The match revealed both the attacking potential and squad turnover challenges Alonso will navigate in his early tenure. His first game demonstrates the competitive depth of Chelsea's forward options.
content: Xabi Alonso's first game as Chelsea manager is defined by four strikers - from one who scored a hat-trick to one who could leave.

zh.title: 阿隆索在切尔西的首场比赛是四名前锋的故事

title: Can lightning strike twice? Cape Verde set for Wafcon debut

content: After the men's success at the World Cup, Cape Verde should not be underestimated on their Women's Africa Cup of Nations debut, forward Sandra Martins warns.

title: Rodri out for 'short period' after back surgery

content: Manchester City midfielder Rodri will be sidelined for a "short period of rehabilitation" following back surgery on Monday.

title: England keeper Hampton extends deal at Chelsea

title: Only use VAR when error blatant - referee chiefs
summary: European refereeing officials have announced that video assistant referees should only be used to overturn "blatantly incorrect" decisions and clear missed incidents. This guidance aims to maintain match flow while addressing obvious errors. The directive signals a more restrained approach to VAR intervention across European football.
content: Video assistant referees should only be used to change "blatantly incorrect" decisions and clear missed incidents, say European refereeing officials.

title: Shootouts & regional fixture split for new-look League Cup
summary: The rebranded Players Cup, formerly the League Cup, will feature a 23-team league phase format with penalty shootouts to settle draws after 90 minutes. This restructuring represents a significant departure from the traditional League Cup format. The new format aims to create more competitive opportunities and eliminate draw outcomes.
content: The Players Cup, formerly the League Cup, will have a 23-team league phase that includes penalty shootouts to settle draws after 90 minutes.
